about: Where Holo Search looks for an app by its address, tried in order. No source is trusted: every byte is hashed in the page and refused unless it matches the address. The canonical Prism index is the hosted kappa registry (registry.uor.foundation): it lists every Prism app that verifies, by its self-verifying address (the holo's BLAKE3 fingerprint and its SHA-256), and resolves either address to the bytes its repository publishes. IPFS sources take the CID that follows from the address (sha256 file, or a holo body by its blake3 fingerprint). Indices are what search runs over; a full address needs none.

sources.name: Prism registry
sources.note: The canonical kappa registry: a Prism app's BLAKE3 fingerprint or SHA-256 redirects to the bytes its repository publishes; an index snapshot's SHA-256 serves it.
